verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs describe an open source toolkit for AI applications built on Postgres and pgvector [supabase-docs-9]. They also say the client libraries can store, index, and query vector embeddings at scale [supabase-docs-76], and the homepage lists vector embeddings as a core product feature [supabase-docs-20, supabase-docs-31]. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of similarity-search operators and index types (e.g. HNSW/IVFFlat) and distance metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of vector search performance.
